text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B at a gain and buying it back later reminded me that locking in profit is not automatically good timing; decide whether to sell based on the position's role and future risk, not the pleasure of realizing a gain.","My average cost and reluctance to admit a mistake should not determine whether I hold or sell; reassess each stock on its merits from today's price.","With unpredictable prices and a long-term horizon, I should favor deliberate, diversified decisions and avoid unnecessary trading based on recent moves."]}
